body.content:
Synthesis of blast-radius ordering with evidence grounding:

The PARKED.md identifies six gaps. The RESULTS.md evidence that 44 checks were vacuous, evadable, dead, or absent, and that ~160 checks proved failable under ~590 reverted mutations, confirms that guard-death defects are the recurring failure class. The ordering is:
1. _reset() guard (digest corruption) — append-only record integrity
2. Lease-mismatch refusal (firewall bypass) — security policy silent failure
3. Unimported functions (resolve_conjecture_route, compile_criticism_assignments) — routing rot
4. Context receipt recovery guard — recovery path failure
5. Torn-tail repair gate — partial coverage exists, marginal gap
6. Census delta (11 vs 14) — observability discrepancy

The key countercondition for Priority 1 is whether WorkflowReplayState.digest is downstream-consumed (SCR_005, SCR_006). If not, Priority 1 may drop. The key countercondition for Priority 2 is whether the lease-mismatch refusal is the sole enforcement site or has defense-in-depth. The key countercondition for Priority 3 is whether the functions are dead code.
body.possible_next_move: Resolve SCR_005/SCR_006: check whether WorkflowReplayState.digest is consumed by any downstream integrity check. This determines whether Priority 1 holds or drops.
body.why_keep_this: This synthesis grounds the ordering in the evidence and makes the counterconditions explicit, so a maintainer can implement test 1 tomorrow and know exactly what would falsify the priority assignment.
